title: configure-module input
description: Configure coupled ns8-mail instance, optional Traefik Secretariat Portal, AD/LDAP groups, and Phase 2/3 Milter, Rspamd (with Basic Auth & TLS verify), Digest, and Connector settings

mail_module_uuid.description: UUID of the coupled ns8-mail module instance

portal_enabled.description: Publish the Secretariat & Quarantine Web Portal via Traefik (default true)

portal_hostname.description: FQDN for the Secretariat Web Portal behind Traefik, or empty string when portal_enabled is false

lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt ACME certificate on Traefik

http2https.description: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS on Traefik

allowed_groups.description: LDAP/AD groups permitted to sign in to the Secretariat Web Portal (empty list disables portal login while keeping Cockpit & public quarantine release active)

portal_tracking_enabled.description: Allow authorized Secretariat Portal users read-only access to Mail-Tracking search

milter_enabled.description: Enable Before-DKIM Postfix signature Milter listener on MILTER_TCP_PORT

rspamd_url.description: Rspamd Controller base URL (e.g. https://mail.example.com/rspamd or http://127.0.0.1:11334)

rspamd_user.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username (e.g. NS8 admin user) for Traefik-protected /rspamd routes

rspamd_password.description: Rspamd password or Basic Auth password (empty preserves existing saved password unless clear_rspamd_password is true)

clear_rspamd_password.description: Explicitly clear the saved Rspamd password

rspamd_tls_verify.description: Verify TLS certificates when connecting to HTTPS Rspamd endpoints (default false for self-signed NS8 certificates)

digest_enabled.description: Enable daily Spam Quarantine Digest emails

digest_time.description: Daily digest delivery time in HH:MM format (default 07:30)

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for scheduled digest runs (default Europe/Berlin)

admin_alert_email.description: Administrator email address notified on external POP3/IMAP connector failures
